Giffany Shapes3D validation summary
===================================

Validated with GCC:
  gcc -O2 -std=c89 -pedantic -Wall -Wextra -Werror

Validated with Clang:
  clang -O2 -std=c89 -pedantic -Wall -Wextra -Werror

Validated as a 32-bit i386 object:
  gcc -m32 -O2 -std=c89 -pedantic -Wall -Wextra -Werror -c g3d_shapes.c
  Result: ELF 32-bit LSB relocatable, Intel i386

Validated with runtime sanitizers:
  -fsanitize=address,undefined

Automated tests cover:
  - Q16.16 multiply, divide, square root and color interpolation.
  - Every mesh generator and its exact buffer-requirement helper.
  - Box, sphere, cone, frustum, capsule and pyramid topology generation.
  - Sphere/sphere, sphere/AABB, ray/sphere and ray/AABB queries.
  - Large-radius sphere separation without squared-distance saturation errors.

A separate winding/normal audit checked every nondegenerate triangle generated for:
  box, prism, pyramid, bipyramid, cylinder, cone, UV sphere, both hemispheres and capsule.
  Result: zero triangles with winding opposed to their supplied vertex normals.

The host did not have a MinGW cross-compiler installed, so Windows linking was not run
here. The library itself compiled as strict freestanding-style C89 and as 32-bit i386;
`build_mingw32.bat` contains the intended MinGW32 commands.
